program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((target (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0))))
         (candidates
          (filter (lambda (obj)
                    (and (= (obj-color obj) target)
                         (all? (lambda (p) (> (first p) 0)) (obj-cells obj))))
                  (objects g 0)))
         (chosen (first (sort candidates
                              (lambda (a b)
                                (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                    (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                                    (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))))
    (subgrid g (obj-r1 chosen) (obj-c1 chosen) (obj-r2 chosen) (obj-c2 chosen))))
